paper.title: Better, Faster, Stronger: Programmatic Skill Learning Best Reduces Agent Cost
paper.abstract: Recently, the practice of augmenting LLM agent capability with skills has gained prevalence. We explore the cost effective adaptation of agents to novel domains by means of learning skills. Existing works focus on performance gain over cost effectiveness. As a result, little is known about what skill learning strategies save cost. We argue that among all the different skill learning methods, those that view skills as programs can achieve the best cost reduction. By executing sequences of actions

summary.core_problem: 在新领域中，LLM agent 如何以更低成本获得可复用技能，而不是只追求任务成功率。
summary.importance: 贡献点在 agent 侧的成本—能力权衡：强调把技能表示成可执行程序，比纯自然语言或隐式策略更省推理成本。这对后训练和 agent 系统设计有启发，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 论文主张 programmatic skill learning：把过去轨迹压缩成可复用程序，后续任务中以确定性执行替代反复试错；并提出 SpeedR 类框架来在推理时增量发现、分析并装备这些程序化技能，不依赖 replay 或额外验证集。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模与数据规模。实验重点应是比较不同技能学习策略在新领域适应中的成本、成功率与长期稳定性，核心 baseline 预计包括无技能 agent、文本技能库和其他 skill learning 方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how LLM agents can acquire reusable skills for new domains with lower cost, rather than optimizing only for task success.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an agent-side cost-performance argument: representing skills as executable programs can reduce inference cost more effectively than implicit or purely textual skills. This is more relevant to post-training and agent systems than to core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It advocates programmatic skill learning, where past trajectories are distilled into reusable programs. Future tasks then execute these programs deterministically instead of relying on repeated trial-and-error. The proposed framework incrementally discovers and equips such skills at inference time without replay or validation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model or dataset scale. The likely experimental focus is cost, success rate, and long-horizon robustness when comparing programmatic skills against no-skill agents, textual skill memories, and other skill-learning baselines.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“把技能外化成程序以换推理算力”这个取舍值得记住；读方法图和成本表就够，不必深挖正文。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the idea of externalizing skills into programs to trade memory for inference cost is worth noting; read the method figure and cost table only.

paper.title: Agentic Instruction Data Selection: Let DataMaster Interpret Your Intent
paper.abstract: Although existing instruction data selection methods have introduced various metrics, the inherent complexity of real-world datasets makes it impractical for any single metric to generalize across all scenarios. Developers are thus often forced to manually inspect data and craft heuristic rules for each new application---a tedious and error-prone process. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift from manual configuration to automated orchestration via the Instruction Data Selection Agent (Data

summary.core_problem: 现有指令数据选择方法依赖单一指标或手动设计启发式规则，无法跨场景泛化，人工筛选成本高且易出错
summary.importance: 提出了Agent驱动的指令数据选择新范式，将手动策略设计转为Agent根据用户自然语言意图自动编排最优筛选策略
summary.technical_approach: 设计DataMaster Agent，接收用户自然语言描述的数据需求，自主组合不同的数据选择算子与策略，完成面向特定场景的指令数据筛选，无需人工编写规则
summary.experiments: 在数学、医学、代码三个领域的指令微调场景下测试，DataMaster的效果优于静态选择基线，且在多数设置下效果超过使用全量指令数据训练的模型

summary_en.core_problem: Existing instruction data selection methods rely on single metrics or manually designed heuristic rules that fail to generalize across scenarios, with high cost and error rate for manual curation.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an agent-driven paradigm for instruction data selection, replacing manual strategy design with automatic orchestration of optimal selection policies based on users' natural language intent.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs the DataMaster agent that takes natural language data requirements from users, autonomously composes different data selection operators and policies to perform scenario-specific instruction data curation without manual rule writing.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on instruction tuning scenarios across math, medical, and code domains, DataMaster outperforms static selection baselines and surpasses full-pool training performance in a majority of settings.

recommendation.zh: 用Agent自动编排指令数据选择策略，对预训练数据筛选的自动化思路有弱参考价值，不用深挖实现细节
recommendation.en: Agent-orchestrated instruction data selection offers minor inspiration for automated pretraining data curation, skip implementation details.

paper.title: EvoMem: Memory-Augmented Evolution for Code Optimization
paper.abstract: Successful mutation strategies in evolutionary code search may contain reusable knowledge that is useful beyond a single run, and in some cases may transfer across related tasks and domains. However, existing LLM-driven evolutionary frameworks largely discard such knowledge, repeatedly rediscovering similar ideas and limiting opportunities for cross-run and cross-task learning. We introduce EvoMem, a persistent memory architecture for LLM-based evolutionary program search that captures and reuse

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM驱动的进化代码搜索框架丢弃跨次运行的成功突变知识，导致重复探索、跨任务迁移能力弱。
summary.importance: 方法创新，为进化式代码优化引入持久化记忆架构，支持跨运行、跨任务的突变知识复用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出EvoMem：1）每次进化运行后，将成功突变事件抽取为带溯源的结构化、任务感知建议存入持久记忆；2）后续运行时根据当前任务与程序上下文检索少量相关指令，引导LLM生成突变；记忆结构区分任务上下文与可复用策略，避免噪声干扰。
summary.experiments: 在几何优化、多跳问答、GPU kernel优化等benchmark上验证：对比无记忆的LLM进化基线，跨运行复用记忆后搜索效率与最终解质量均有提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM-driven evolutionary code search frameworks discard successful mutation knowledge across runs, causing redundant exploration and poor cross-task transfer.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: a persistent memory architecture for evolutionary code optimization that enables cross-run and cross-task mutation knowledge reuse.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoMem operates in two phases: (1) after each evolutionary run, successful mutation events are extracted into structured, task-aware advice with provenance and stored in persistent memory; (2) during subsequent runs, a small set of relevant instructions is retrieved based on task and program context to guide LLM mutation generation, with memory structure separating task context from reusable strategies to reduce noise.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on geometric optimization, multi-hop QA, and GPU kernel optimization benchmarks; compared to memory-less LLM evolutionary baselines, cross-run memory reuse improves both search efficiency and final solution quality.

recommendation.zh: 代码进化搜索的记忆增强技巧，对预训练无直接启发，若做代码Agent训练数据合成可参考其突变结构化思路。
recommendation.en: Memory-augmented trick for evolutionary code search; no direct pretraining insight, but its structured mutation formulation may inform coding-agent training data synthesis pipelines.

paper.title: GraphThink: Graph-Enhanced LLM Thinking for Long-Horizon Embodied Task Planning
paper.abstract: Embodied agents using LLM-based planners often struggle with physical hallucinations, poor generalization to long-horizon tasks, and lack of environmental awareness. We propose GraphThink, a novel framework that integrates a task graph to provide structured knowledge for robust planning and a scene graph to maintain environmental memory for event-driven replanning. Specifically, the task graph guides LLM thinking through contextual prompting and iterative refinement, effectively mitigating plann

summary.core_problem: 基于LLM的具身Agent规划器存在物理幻觉、长周期任务泛化差、环境感知不足的核心问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出任务图+场景图的双图增强规划框架，首次将结构化图知识与GRPO细粒度奖励设计结合用于长周期具身规划训练
summary.technical_approach: 1. 任务图通过上下文提示与迭代细化引导LLM思考，减少规划幻觉；2. 在GRPO框架下利用任务图设计细粒度奖励，训练规划器提升长周期能力与泛化性；3. 场景图驱动的事件驱动重规划模块实现闭环环境感知与纠错
summary.experiments: 在ALFRED具身任务基准上取得SOTA性能，其高层规划器在v1、v2数据拆分上均超过主流闭源API大模型

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-based embodied agent planners suffer from physical hallucinations, poor long-horizon task generalization, and insufficient environmental awareness
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a dual-graph enhanced planning framework combining task graph and scene graph, the first to integrate structured graph prior with fine-grained GRPO reward design for long-horizon embodied planning training
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Task graph guides LLM thinking via contextual prompting and iterative refinement to reduce planning hallucinations; 2. Fine-grained GRPO reward designed based on task graph to train planner for better long-horizon capability and generalization; 3. Scene-graph powered event-driven replanning for closed-loop environmental awareness and error correction
summary_en.experiments: Achieves SOTA performance on the ALFRED embodied task benchmark; its high-level planner outperforms leading closed-source API-based LLMs on both v1 and v2 splits

recommendation.zh: 重点看§3.2的GRPO细粒度奖励构造部分，对规划类能力的后训练奖励设计有直接参考价值
recommendation.en: Focus on §3.2 for the fine-grained GRPO reward construction, which provides direct reference for post-training reward design for planning capabilities

paper.title: Fisher-R1: Training LLM Agents for Reliable Hypothesis Testing
paper.abstract: Reliable hypothesis testing is the foundation of many empirical scientific claims. Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used to automate this process, as they can inspect datasets, generate code, and produce analyses end-to-end. However, we show that they frequently make subtle inferential errors that lead to incorrect conclusions despite correctly executed analyses. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this failure mode, as they rarely assess whether a reported p-value is statistic

summary.core_problem: LLM coding agent 在做开放式假设检验时，经常能写出可运行代码并得到数值结果，但会在统计方法选择、前提假设检查和结论推断上出错，导致 p 值和结论在统计上无效；现有数据分析 benchmark 没有系统评估这种“代码能跑但推断错误”的失效模式。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线的直接启发有限，更接近特定科研 agent 能力评测与 post-training。但论文指出的问题有方法论意义：很多 agent benchmark 只验证“有没有执行出结果”，而不验证“执行的方法是否对应该问题和数据生成假设”。这一点和预训练后“模型能生成流畅回答但推理链/验证链不可靠”是同类评估缺口。对做 agent/RM/verifier、尤其是 code-and-tool-use agent 的研究者有参考价值；对纯基座预训练读者，可作为“评测必须验证过程合法性而非只看终态答案”的案例。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 P-Bench，包含 425 个开放式假设检验任务，覆盖经济学、生物学、医学等真实科学数据。每个任务提供问题、数据集和数据描述，agent 需要在 R 执行环境中多轮交互，自行选择统计方法、运行分析、报告 p 值并给出拒绝/不拒绝原假设的结论。答案以可执行的参考分析为基础，经过领域专家审核，重点比对方法选择、p 值准确性和结论正确性，而非只看代码是否运行或报告是否流畅。在此基础上训练 Fisher-R1：先用合成生成的、带验证答案的假设检验任务做 SFT，再用基于结果正确性的 RL 训练。
summary.experiments: P-Bench 共 425 个任务，来源于同行评议论文和权威生物统计教学材料，答案键绑定到可执行参考分析。Fisher-R1-14B 在该 benchmark 上报告超过 GPT-5.4 与 DeepSeek-V4-Pro；论文展示的典型失效是模型识别到异常值/模型误设等警告信号，但仍选择错误的检验方法（如在高杠杆点存在时继续用线性回归而改用秩检验），从而得到显著但不可靠的 p 值。实验重点在 p 值准确性和结论正确性两个维度，而不是一般数据问答任务上的通过率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点看引言里的失效模式例子（识别警告但做错误方法选择）、P-Bench 的任务设计与答案构造方式，以及为什么要把“方法选择 + p 值 + 结论”绑定在可执行参考分析上，而不是只让评委看自然语言报告。训练部分对纯预训练读者不是重点；若关心 agent post-training，可看合成任务生成和 outcome-grounded RL 的设计。预计阅读时间 15–20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM coding agents can often produce runnable code and numerical outputs for open-ended hypothesis-testing tasks, yet still make subtle inferential mistakes—choosing the wrong test, ignoring modeling assumptions, or drawing invalid conclusions—so the reported p-values are not statistically valid; existing data-analysis benchmarks do not systematically measure this failure mode.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core pretraining contribution and sits closer to domain-specific agent evaluation and post-training. Its broader relevance is methodological: many agent benchmarks reward executable workflows or plausible final answers without checking whether the chosen procedure is actually valid given the question and data-generating assumptions. This is the same class of evaluation gap that appears whenever fluent generation masks flawed reasoning or unverified tool use. It is useful for researchers working on agents, verifiers, reward modeling, and code-and-tool use; for pure pretraining readers it mainly serves as a concrete example that evaluation must validate procedural correctness, not just end-state answers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces P-Bench, a benchmark of 425 open-ended hypothesis-testing tasks built from real scientific datasets across economics, biology, and medicine. For each task the agent receives a scientific question, a dataset, and a description, and must interact with an R execution environment across multiple turns to choose a statistical method, run the analysis, report a p-value, and decide whether to reject the null. Answer keys are grounded in logged executions of canonical reference analyses and audited by domain experts, scoring method choice, p-value accuracy, and conclusion correctness rather than code executability or report fluency alone. Fisher-R1 is then trained by supervised fine-tuning on synthetically generated hypothesis-testing tasks with verified keys, followed by reinforcement learning using outcome-grounded rewards.
summary_en.experiments: P-Bench contains 425 tasks drawn from peer-reviewed papers and authoritative biostatistics teaching materials, with answer keys tied to executable reference analyses. Fisher-R1-14B is reported to outperform strong baselines including GPT-5.4 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro on P-Bench. A representative failure case is that frontier agents can recognize warning signs such as high-leverage outliers but still proceed with an inappropriate test—for example, using linear regression where a rank-based test is required—producing a runnable analysis and fluent narrative with an invalid, yet statistically significant-looking, p-value. The main evaluation axes are p-value accuracy and conclusion correctness rather than generic data-analysis task completion.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this paper. Focus on the introduction for the motivating failure mode—recognizing diagnostic warnings while making the wrong inferential choice—and on the P-Bench design, especially why answer keys must be tied to executable reference analyses that score method, p-value, and conclusion jointly instead of grading natural-language reports in isolation. The training recipe for Fisher-R1 is secondary unless you work on agent post-training; if so, look at the synthetic task generator and outcome-grounded RL setup. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: P-Bench 对做 agent 评测的人有参考价值，Fisher-R1 的 RL 训练 recipe 可看，但核心是统计推断这个特定垂直场景，通用 pretrain 启发有限。
recommendation.en: P-Bench is useful for agent evaluation researchers and Fisher-R1's RL recipe is worth a look, but the statistical-inference vertical limits general pretraining insight.

paper.title: HarnessOpt-Bench: Evaluating LLMs at Harness Optimization
paper.abstract: As LLMs are increasingly deployed within agentic systems, their capabilities depend not only on the model weights but also on the harness: the prompts, tools, control flow, memory, and orchestration code surrounding them. This makes automated harness optimization -- the iterative and evaluation-guided improvement of a harness by an AI system -- both an important route to improving AI systems and a demanding capability for AI systems themselves. Yet the community lacks a common protocol for measu

summary.core_problem: 论文要评测的是 AI 系统能否在固定预算内自动优化另一个 agent 的 harness。这里的 harness 包括 prompt、工具、控制流、记忆和编排代码。难点不在单次代码修改，而在昂贵、随机、反馈不完整的评测环境下，判断哪些修改真的提升了目标 agent。
summary.importance: 这篇更适合放在 agent/eval 方向泛读。它对预训练本身没有直接方法贡献，但对 post-train 后的系统能力评测有参考价值。LLM 的实际能力越来越依赖外部 harness，单看模型权重会漏掉一部分系统层能力。论文的价值在于把“自动改进 agent 系统”从单个 demo 拆成可复现协议：固定目标模型、隔离 held-out test、限制评测预算、记录所有候选版本。这个设计能帮助区分模型能力、coding harness 能力和评测协议带来的噪声。
summary.technical_approach: HarnessOpt-Bench 把 harness optimization 定义成受约束的随机程序优化问题。优化器由一个 LLM 和 coding harness 组成，输入是目标 agent 的 seed harness、开发/验证反馈和有限的目标评测预算。优化器可以编辑 harness 代码库，但必须遵守固定执行接口和不可变路径约束。最终它提名一个候选 harness，在搜索期间不可访问的 test split 上打分，指标是相对 seed harness 的 normalized gain。协议强调三点：开发、验证、测试拆分固定且不重叠；held-out test 在搜索期间不可见，避免优化器拟合可见分数；trusted execution environment 负责权限隔离、预算计量、资源记录和候选版本审计。与以往自带目标 agent、自带预算、自带评测方式的 harness optimization 工作不同，这里把 optimizer model、coding harness、target agent 和 evaluation protocol 分离出来。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 4 个下游任务，任务类型强调评测昂贵且随机，例如 fixed-corpus research 和 terminal use。论文在共享 coding harness 下评测 5 个 frontier optimizer models，同时也评测这些模型各自的 native harness，共得到 111 个 scored optimizer runs；另在一个任务上额外评测 2 个 coding harness。主要结果是：在 paired design 下，共享 harness 内不同 optimizer model 的差异，平均大于 shared harness 与 native harness 的差异；native harness 没有稳定优势。可获得的提升强烈依赖任务和 seed regime。OfficeQA 的 release-level 实验显示该 benchmark 能分辨连续模型版本之间的差异。轨迹分析显示，更广泛的系统级干预与更高 held-out gain 相关；细粒度 failure trace 检查使用较少，并且没有观察到与提升的正相关。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 expensive and stochastic evaluation 的问题定义，以及 HarnessOpt-Bench 协议部分，重点理解为什么要固定 target model/environment/verifier，并把 final test 完全隔离。实验部分可重点看 RQ1/RQ3：模型差异与 coding harness 差异的 paired comparison。Section 5.2 的 OfficeQA release-level 分析和 Section 5.3 的搜索轨迹分析值得扫一遍，它们展示了 benchmark 是否能分辨模型进步，以及当前 optimizer 的失败模式。无需细读每个任务的业务细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether an AI system can optimize another agent’s harness under a fixed budget. The harness includes prompts, tools, control flow, memory, and orchestration code. The core difficulty is not ordinary coding, but making reliable system-level improvements when evaluation is expensive, stochastic, and only partially observed.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a skim-worthy agent evaluation paper rather than a pretraining method paper. Its relevance is in the interface between model capability and system capability. As LLM deployments depend heavily on harnesses, evaluating only the base model or the chat model misses an important layer. The benchmark contributes a controlled protocol: fixed target model and environment, held-out final evaluation, strict budget enforcement, and full candidate auditing. This helps separate optimizer-model ability from coding-harness effects and protocol noise.
summary_en.technical_approach: HarnessOpt-Bench formulates harness optimization as constrained stochastic program optimization. An optimizer, consisting of an LLM plus a coding harness, receives a seed harness, graded development and validation feedback, and a limited target-evaluation budget. It may edit the executable harness codebase while respecting a fixed interface and immutable paths. The final submitted candidate is evaluated on an inaccessible test split, using normalized gain over the seed harness as the score. The protocol relies on fixed non-overlapping dev/validation/test splits, graded disclosure, and a trusted execution environment that enforces access control, meters target evaluations and resources, isolates held-out state, and versions all candidates. This differs from prior demonstrations where each method often used its own target agent, seed, budget, and scoring protocol.
summary_en.experiments: The suite contains 4 downstream tasks designed to have costly and noisy evaluation, including fixed-corpus research and terminal-use settings. The authors evaluate 5 frontier optimizer models under a shared coding harness and under their respective native harnesses, producing 111 scored optimizer runs. They also evaluate 2 additional coding harnesses on one task. Under this paired setup, differences among optimizer models within the shared harness are larger on average than differences between shared and native harnesses. Native harnesses do not provide a consistent advantage. Achievable gains vary strongly by task and seed regime. On OfficeQA, release-level experiments show that the benchmark can resolve variation across successive optimizer-model releases. Instrumented trajectories suggest that broader interventions correlate with higher held-out gain, while detailed failure-trace inspection is rare and not positively associated with gain.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the Introduction’s framing of expensive stochastic evaluation and the benchmark protocol definition. The key design choices are the fixed target environment, inaccessible final test split, and trusted execution boundary. In the experiments, prioritize the paired comparison for RQ1/RQ3, which separates optimizer-model effects from coding-harness effects. Section 5.2 on OfficeQA release-level sensitivity and Section 5.3 on search trajectories are the most useful parts for understanding what the benchmark actually measures. The task-specific implementation details can be read selectively.

recommendation.zh: 做agent能力预训练或对齐的研究员重点看任务设计与打分规则，可直接复用为内部agent系统能力探测集
recommendation.en: For agent pretraining or alignment researchers, focus on task design and scoring metrics; directly reusable as an internal agent system capability probe set

paper.title: EvoHarness-RL: Learning Self-Evolving Runtime Harness for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents increasingly rely on external execution support to maintain state, track progress, invoke tools, verify outcomes, and reuse experience across interactions. However, effective harness use raises two coupled challenges: state formation from noisy interaction traces and runtime control over external-state access. Existing agents usually handle both through prompts, heuristics, or domain-specific conventions, leaving the external workspace and its usage policy manually engine

summary.core_problem: 长程 Agent 往往依赖外部状态、工具、记忆和执行日志，但什么时候读、写、更新、压缩这些外部 harness，通常靠 prompt 或人工规则。论文要解决的是 harness policy learning：让模型学习运行时如何构造和使用外部状态，而不是只把 harness 当作固定脚手架。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不是基座预训练论文，和 LLM 训练的关系主要在 agent RL 和训练信号设计。它的启发在于把“外部状态使用”显式纳入策略学习，并对调用成本建模。对预训练研究的间接价值是：长程任务能力不只来自更长上下文或更多轨迹 SFT，也可能来自模型学会何时把状态外化、何时依赖内部策略、何时复用经验。这对 long-horizon agent post-training、工具使用 RL、记忆增强模型有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: EvoHarness-RL 把复杂的外部执行支持抽象成 BPE workspace：Belief 表示当前环境状态，Progress 表示已完成和待完成子目标，Experience 表示跨 episode 可复用经验。Agent 通过紧凑的 harness meta-actions 与这些状态交互，例如查询 belief、提交 progress、召回 experience、写入新 insight。训练分两阶段。第一阶段是 supervised harness fine-tuning，让模型熟悉 BPE action protocol，并从交互轨迹中学习如何外化 belief、progress 和 experience。第二阶段使用 cost-aware GRPO，把 harness action 的成本纳入优化，因为读写外部状态会占用交互预算。奖励包含任务成功、效率、动作多样性、避免重复和动作格式合法性。方法的重点是把 harness 使用从 prompt-time 规则转成 learned runtime policy。
summary.experiments: 论文在 ALFWorld 上实例化 BPE：Belief 对应 world-state tracker，Progress 对应已提交的子目标计划，Experience 对应跨 episode skill bank。结果显示，仅在 prompt 中加入 BPE 已能改善有状态长程任务；经过 SFT 和 GRPO 后，ALFWorld seen split 成功率达到 96.9%，unseen split 达到 86.6%。分析部分提出两个现象。第一是 harness annealing：训练后模型减少频繁、脚手架式的外部调用，转向更选择性的状态访问，说明部分固定模式被内化进策略。第二是 harness evolution：在线 progress 更新和跨 episode experience consolidation 会把外部状态逐渐压缩成更适合当前任务族的支持结构。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Method 的 BPE 抽象和 action protocol，再看两阶段训练 recipe，尤其是 cost-aware GRPO 的奖励设计。实验部分关注 ALFWorld 适配方式、seen/unseen 成功率，以及 harness annealing 的调用频率变化。若只关心基座预训练，可以跳过环境细节，重点看外部状态如何被表示成可学习动作，以及成本约束如何改变 Agent 的运行时策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses harness policy learning for long-horizon LLM agents. Agents often rely on external state, tools, memories, trackers, and logs, but the policy for when to read, write, update, or consolidate this support is usually hand-designed through prompts or heuristics. EvoHarness-RL trains the model to coordinate with the harness at runtime.
summary_en.importance: This is not a base pretraining paper. Its relevance is mainly to agent post-training, RL for tool and memory use, and long-horizon execution. The useful idea is to make external-state access part of the learned policy and to price that access explicitly. For pretraining researchers, it suggests that long-horizon capability may depend not only on longer context or more trajectory imitation, but also on whether models learn when to externalize state, when to rely on internal computation, and when to reuse prior experience.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoHarness-RL abstracts heterogeneous runtime support into a BPE workspace. Belief tracks the current environment state, Progress tracks completed and pending subgoals, and Experience stores reusable cross-episode knowledge. The agent interacts with this workspace through compact harness meta-actions, such as querying belief, committing progress, recalling experience, and writing new insights. Training has two stages. Supervised harness fine-tuning teaches the model the BPE action protocol and how to extract useful belief, progress, and experience from traces. Cost-aware GRPO then optimizes when to use the harness under an interaction budget. The reward includes task success, efficiency, action diversity, repetition avoidance, and valid action formatting. The main contribution is turning harness use from a prompt-time scaffold into a learned runtime control policy.
summary_en.experiments: The framework is instantiated in ALFWorld. In this environment, Belief is grounded as a world-state tracker, Progress as a committed subgoal plan, and Experience as a cross-episode skill bank for household tasks. Prompt-time BPE already improves stateful long-horizon execution. After SFT and GRPO, the reported success rate reaches 96.9% on the ALFWorld seen split and 86.6% on the unseen split. The analysis highlights two dynamics. Harness annealing means that training reduces frequent scaffold-like calls and shifts the agent toward selective external-state access. Harness evolution means that online progress updates and experience consolidation refine the external workspace into a more compact task-adaptive substrate.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read the Method section for the BPE abstraction, the action protocol, and the two-stage training recipe. Pay particular attention to the cost-aware GRPO reward, because it determines whether the agent learns selective rather than excessive harness use. In the experiments, focus on the ALFWorld adapter, the seen and unseen success rates, and the analysis of harness annealing. Readers focused on base-model research can skip most environment details and concentrate on the representation of external state as learnable actions and the effect of cost constraints on runtime policy.

recommendation.zh: 用RL学习Agent运行时harness的思路新颖，cost-aware GRPO的设计对后训练RL优化有参考
recommendation.en: RL-learned agent runtime harness is novel; cost-aware GRPO design is relevant for post-training RL research.

paper.title: MemArbiter: Decision-Time Memory Arbitration for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents must retain and use cross-step information to act coherently in long-horizon tasks. Existing methods improve memory accessibility, yet action-relevant information may still fail to guide the current decision because it is poorly formed, organized, prioritized, or presented. We call this post-access failure the Memory-Action Gap. We propose MemArbiter, a function-aware memory arbitration framework that addresses the memory-management-induced component of this gap

summary.core_problem: 现有长时序LLM智能体记忆模块主要解决信息存储和检索的可访问性问题，但存在未被明确定义的失效模式：与当前决策相关的信息已经被记忆系统获取，却因组织方式、优先级排序、呈现形式不合理，无法有效引导行动选择，该问题被定义为「记忆-行动间隙」，与已有的遗忘、检索失败两类问题有明确区别。
summary.importance: 该工作提出的功能分层记忆、动态仲裁调度思路，对长上下文建模、智能体导向的预训练记忆结构设计有参考价值，尤其是不同类型记忆的差异化激活、粒度控制逻辑，可启发预训练阶段的结构化注意力、分层记忆等方向的设计。
summary.technical_approach: MemArbiter是一套功能感知的动态记忆仲裁框架：首先将交互历史拆解为原子记忆项，按决策功能划分为5个独立记忆库——目标、任务状态、约束、情景经历、参考事实；每个记忆项支持两种呈现粒度：信息完整的焦点形式、信息精简的外围形式；每一步决策时，先计算记忆库层面的当前任务需求度、记忆项层面的决策相关度，再通过时序呈现门控对每个记忆项执行提升、降级、保留、隐藏四类操作，最终在固定的每步token预算下，将选中的焦点和外围记忆组装为结构化prompt送入模型生成行动。
summary.experiments: 基于ReAct智能体在ALFWorld具身任务基准上评测，严格对齐所有对比方法的每步记忆token预算：500token预算下成功率达82.8%，750token预算下达92.5%，分别比最强基线高20.9和25.4个百分点；消融实验验证功能分库、双粒度呈现、时序门控三个核心组件均有独立贡献；MemArbiter同时提升了行动失败后的单步恢复率，显著减少了重复失败行动、状态-行动循环的问题，实验结果在开源权重模型和闭源模型上保持一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注「记忆-行动间隙」的定义、五个功能记忆库的设计逻辑、动态优先级调度机制，可进一步思考这类功能拆分思路是否可下沉到预训练层面的注意力偏置、结构化记忆架构设计中，预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者所属机构未在提供的公开内容中明确标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing memory modules for long-horizon LLM agents primarily address information storage and retrieval accessibility, but suffer from an undocumented failure mode: action-relevant information is already accessible to the memory pipeline, yet fails to guide action selection due to poor organization, prioritization, or presentation. This failure mode is formalized as the 'Memory-Action Gap', distinct from well-documented issues of forgetting and retrieval failure.
summary_en.importance: The proposed function-tiered memory organization and dynamic arbitration mechanism offers useful reference for long-context modeling and memory design for agent-centric pretraining, particularly the logic of differentiated activation and granularity control for different memory types, which can inspire structured attention and hierarchical memory designs at the pretraining stage.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemArbiter is a function-aware dynamic memory arbitration framework. It first decomposes interaction history into atomic memory items, which are organized into five independent functional memory banks: Goal, Task State, Constraint, Episodic Trace, and Reference Fact. Each item supports two rendering granularities: a fully detailed focal form, and a compact ambient form. At each decision step, the framework computes bank-level demand for the current task context and item-level relevance to the pending decision, then applies one of four operations to each item via a temporal presentation gate: promote, demote, retain, or hide. Selected focal and ambient memories are assembled into a structured prompt under a fixed per-step token budget for action generation.
summary_en.experiments: Implemented on a ReAct agent and evaluated on the ALFWorld embodied task benchmark, with strictly matched per-step memory token budgets across all methods. MemArbiter achieves 82.8% success rate under a 500-token budget and 92.5% under a 750-token budget, outperforming the strongest baseline by 20.9 and 25.4 percentage points respectively. Ablation studies confirm independent contributions from all three core components: functional bank separation, dual-granularity representation, and temporal gating. MemArbiter also delivers higher one-step recovery rates after action failures, substantially reduces repeated failed actions and state-action loops, with consistent results across both open-weight and proprietary models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommended. Focus on the formal definition of the Memory-Action Gap, the design rationale for the five functional memory banks, and the dynamic priority scheduling mechanism. Consider whether such functional decomposition could be incorporated into pretraining-level designs such as attention bias or structured memory architectures. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author affiliations are not specified in the provided public content.

recommendation.zh: 分库记忆+动态门控的决策时仲裁思路，可迁移到长上下文预训练的记忆组织设计，重点看§3记忆银行定义与ALFWorld结果表。
recommendation.en: The banked memory + dynamic gating design transfers to long-context pretraining memory organization; focus on §3 memory bank definitions and ALFWorld result tables.

paper.title: Why Formal Monitors Fail: Attack Distribution Entropy as a Coverage Bound for LTL-Based LLM Agent Safety
paper.abstract: Runtime safety monitors based on Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) and finite automata (FSA) are increasingly deployed to intercept unsafe tool-call sequences in LLM agents. Yet the same monitor achieves 68-75% attack coverage on some model architectures and near-zero on others, with no explanation from capability scores, training data, or prompt design. We provide the missing theory. We prove that the recall of any fixed-invariant FSA monitor is bounded above by the concentration of the attack distri

summary.core_problem: 为什么同一套基于 LTL 和有限自动机的运行时安全监控器，在某些 LLM 架构上能拦截大部分攻击，在另一些架构上却几乎失效，而且这种差异无法由模型能力分数、训练数据或提示设计解释。
summary.importance: 论文不属于预训练核心方向，但其结论对安全评测和部署有启发：固定规则集的覆盖率受攻击分布集中度的信息论约束。当模型生成的攻击轨迹高度分散时，增加规则数量或重新训练监控器都无法根本解决问题。这一点对理解数据分布、规则式安全过滤和模型行为多样性之间的关系有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者证明了 entropy-coverage bound：对于包含 k 个固定 LTL 不变量的 FSA 监控器，其召回率上界由攻击分布中前 k 个最频繁 trigger-completion 模式的概率和决定。低熵分布意味着攻击集中在少数模式上，固定规则集可以获得高召回；高熵分布意味着攻击分散在大量结构不同的模式上，任何可接受规模的固定规则集都只能覆盖其中一小部分。论文还提出一个部署前熵测试，用 50–100 条攻击轨迹估计分布熵，预测某后端上 FSA 监控器是否可能有效。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个前沿 LLM 架构、847 条对抗轨迹上测量攻击分布熵。熵与监控覆盖率呈强负相关：Pearson r = -0.87，p = 0.005，bootstrap 95% 置信区间为 [-0.98, -0.78]，留一法相关系数在 [-0.91, -0.82]；熵解释了 76% 的覆盖率方差。Elo 能力分数与覆盖率的 Spearman 相关不显著，|ρ| < 0.35，p > 0.4。结果支持覆盖率差异来自攻击分布熵，而非模型能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看第三节的 entropy-coverage bound 定理及其直觉，以及实证部分关于熵与覆盖率相关性的结果。若关注安全部署，可看部署前熵测试的设计。预计阅读时间约 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Why the same LTL-based finite-state safety monitor can block most attacks on some LLM architectures but nearly none on others, even when model capability scores, training data, and prompt design do not explain the gap.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it carries a useful lesson for safety evaluation and deployment: the recall of a fixed rule set is bounded by how concentrated the attack distribution is. When a model produces highly diverse attack trajectories, adding more rules or retraining the monitor cannot solve the coverage problem by itself. The result is relevant whenever fixed filters, invariants, or pattern-based safety policies meet high-entropy model behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proves an entropy-coverage bound: for a monitor with k fixed LTL invariants, recall is upper-bounded by the total probability mass of the k most frequent trigger-completion patterns in the attack distribution. Low-entropy attacks concentrate on a few patterns, so a fixed invariant set can achieve high recall. High-entropy attacks spread across many structurally different patterns, so any tractable fixed set covers only a small fraction. The authors also propose a pre-deployment entropy test that estimates attack-distribution entropy from 50–100 trajectories and predicts whether an FSA monitor is likely to provide meaningful coverage on a given backend.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study covers eight frontier LLM architectures and 847 adversarial trajectories. Attack-distribution entropy is strongly negatively correlated with monitor coverage: Pearson r = -0.87, p = 0.005, bootstrap 95% CI [-0.98, -0.78], and leave-one-out correlations in [-0.91, -0.82]. Entropy explains 76% of the variance in coverage. Elo capability scores are not significantly correlated with coverage, with |ρ| < 0.35 and p > 0.4, supporting entropy rather than capability as the operative predictor.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Section 3 for the entropy-coverage theorem and its intuition, then the empirical validation showing entropy versus monitor coverage. Readers interested in deployment can look at the proposed pre-deployment entropy test. Estimated reading time: about 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 从理论层面解释了 Agent 安全监视器失效的原因，将覆盖率与攻击分布的熵联系起来，对设计更鲁棒的 Agent 系统有启发。
recommendation.en: Theoretically explains the failure of Agent safety monitors by linking coverage to the entropy of the attack distribution, offering insights for designing more robust Agent systems.

paper.title: NeSyFS: A Neuro-symbolic Fast-Slow Thinking Framework for LLM Agent under Partial Observability
paper.abstract: Recently Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in applications such as self-reflection, retrieval-augmented generation, and scientific discovery. In these settings, agents must act based on limited observations rather than full environmental states, leading to partial observability. This introduces several key challenges: belief state inference, task objective misalignment, and planning under uncertainty. Prior approaches typically condition actions on

summary.core_problem: 在部分可观测环境中，LLM agent 只依赖完整或摘要化历史会被冗余、无关信息误导，导致 belief state、目标对齐和不确定性规划都不稳定。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 agent 架构改进。它尝试把知识图谱 belief state 与 fast-slow thinking 结合，用结构化状态缓解 partial observability；但从摘要看更像已有认知式 agent 组件的组合，离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: NeSyFS 使用知识图谱表示 belief state，并把图中的 triplets 作为各模块上下文；fast-thinking 模块负责反应式决策，slow-thinking 模块预计用于更审慎的规划、反思或修正。方法属于 neuro-symbolic agent 框架，核心是用 KG 过滤历史并维护可解释状态。
summary.experiments: 摘要截断，未给出任务、模型、baseline、参数规模或量化结果。无法判断其在 partial-observability benchmark 上相对 ReAct、Reflexion、memory-based agents 等方法的收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets LLM agents under partial observability, where conditioning on full or summarized histories can inject redundant and irrelevant information and destabilize belief tracking, objective alignment, and planning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general agent-architecture proposal. It combines a knowledge-graph belief state with fast-slow thinking to handle partial observability, but from the abstract it appears closer to a recombination of existing cognitive-agent components than to a foundation-model pretraining result.
summary_en.technical_approach: NeSyFS represents the belief state as a knowledge graph and feeds its triplets as context to each module. A fast-thinking module handles reactive decisions, while the slow-thinking path is presumably used for more deliberate planning or correction. The core idea is to replace raw history conditioning with a structured, interpretable state.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is truncated and does not provide tasks, models, baselines, parameter scales, or quantitative results. It is therefore hard to assess gains over ReAct, Reflexion, or memory-based agents on partial-observability benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: KG belief state 是合理工程补丁，但摘要看不出干净 ablation；只扫实验表，确认是否真赢过 history-summary baseline。
recommendation.en: A KG belief state is a plausible engineering patch, but the abstract shows no clean ablation; just check whether it beats history-summary baselines.

paper.title: Living-Harness Is an Interactive-Agent Evolver

Static harnesses improve reliability through fixed tools, context, memory, and workflow structures, but remain unchanged after deployment. summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent的harness（工具、上下文、记忆、工作流结构）是静态的，部署后不会更新，导致相同的执行失败会在后续任务中反复出现。
summary.importance: 方法/系统创新，首次提出自进化的Agent harness框架，通过轨迹反馈动态更新程序性知识，提升Agent的长期可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Living-Harness框架，基于领域级Evolution-SOP标准操作流程，从完成的轨迹中提取episode抽象和结构化更新证据，写入两种互补的程序性知识：记录触发条件/失败模式/恢复动作的情景记忆，以及记录状态节点/修复边/转移规则的状态图，实现harness的有界更新。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要截断，未披露完整实验设置与量化结果。
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学、阿里巴巴集团、香港城市大学、香港科技大学、密歇根大学联合研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent harnesses (tools, context, memory, workflow structures) are static and do not update after deployment, causing the same execution failures to recur in subsequent tasks.
summary_en.importance: Methodological / system innovation; first self-evolving agent harness framework that dynamically updates procedural knowledge via trajectory feedback to improve long-term agent reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposed Living-Harness framework, guided by a domain-level Evolution-SOP, extracts episode abstraction and structured update evidence from completed trajectories, and writes two complementary forms of procedural knowledge: episodic memory (trigger conditions, failure patterns, recovery actions) and state graphs (state nodes, repair edges, transition rules), enabling bounded harness updates.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; full experimental setup and quantitative results are not disclosed in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Joint research by Zhejiang University, Alibaba Group, City University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, and University of Michigan.

recommendation.zh: Agent自进化harness的思路有新意，核心是把失败轨迹转化为程序性知识，做Agent预训练的可参考其知识表示方式。
recommendation.en: The self-evolving agent harness idea is novel; core is converting failure trajectories into procedural knowledge, useful reference for agent pretraining knowledge representation.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: SkillRise: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Cross-Task Skill Evolution
paper.abstract: Large language model agents often encounter related yet distinct tasks that share reusable solution patterns. Yet standard agentic reinforcement learning treats tasks as independent episodes, while existing approaches to skill learning either focus on repeated attempts of one task or use pipelines with multiple stages that entangle extraction, retrieval, and execution. We introduce SkillRise, a unified reinforcement learning framework for learning skills across tasks. SkillRise organizes related

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent强化学习方法将任务视为独立片段，无法有效积累跨任务可复用技能的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出统一的跨任务技能进化RL框架，解耦任务求解与技能管理的信用分配。
summary.technical_approach: 将相关实例组织为渐进难度序列，单策略交替执行任务求解和技能文档维护；用跨任务解耦信用分配，当前任务结果监督求解，下游折扣结果监督技能 curation。
summary.experiments: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld三个基准上测试，Pass@1超过所有对比基线，摘要未披露具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agentic RL methods treat tasks as independent episodes, failing to accumulate reusable skills across related LLM agent tasks.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation proposing a unified RL framework for cross-task skill evolution with decoupled credit assignment for solving and curation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Organizes related instances into progressive difficulty sequences, a single policy alternates between task solving and curating an evolving skill document; decoupled cross-task credit assignment supervises solving with current outcome and curation with discounted downstream outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld benchmarks, achieves the strongest Pass@1 among compared methods, specific gain magnitude not disclosed in abstract.

recommendation.zh: Agent跨任务技能学习的增量方法，解耦信用分配的思路对RL后训练有微弱启发，看摘要和实验表即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental agent cross-task skill learning method, decoupled credit assignment gives weak insight for RL post-training, check abstract and tables only.

paper.title: Addressable Recall Compaction for Long Context-Window Control in AI Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate reasoning traces, actions, and tool observations that can eventually exceed a model's fixed context window. summary.importance: 方法创新（提出无需微调的写时准入机制）+ 基准贡献（构建两个真实对话评测集），填补了Agent内存写时校验的研究空白。

paper.title: AttriMem: Attribution-Guided Process Feedback for Agent Memory Learning
paper.abstract: Effective memory is crucial for LLM agents, yet constructing it effectively remains challenging. A memory-construction policy decides what information to extract, store, update, compress, or discard as interactions accumulate. Heuristic memory methods rely on subjective, task-specific rules, which can misalign with downstream objectives and limit cross-task adaptability. RL-based methods, by contrast, learn from task feedback but mainly use outcome- or module-level rewards. These coarse signals

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 的记忆构建策略需要在长交互中决定抽取、存储、更新、压缩、丢弃哪些信息。现有 RL 记忆学习方法主要依赖结果级或动作级奖励，无法指出中间记忆内容中哪些具体 token 真正支撑了最终答案，存在细粒度信用分配瓶颈；而人工构造中间过程的 ground truth 又因推理轨迹的不确定性而不可行。
summary.importance: 对 Agent 记忆学习的过程监督设计有参考价值，属于 post-train / Agent 方法范畴，与基座预训练的直接关联较弱。核心启发在于：把最终任务表现通过归因（attribution）转化为对中间记忆输出的 token 级密集奖励，是一种不依赖人工过程标注的细粒度反馈构造方式，思路上与把 outcome reward 反传到中间过程的其他 credit-assignment 技术相通。
summary.technical_approach: AttriMem 在标准 RL 记忆学习流水线之上增加一层归因引导的过程反馈。训练时，策略先产生中间记忆输出，固定的检索-回答接口生成最终答案，结果奖励评估整体任务表现。在此之外，AttriMem 通过遮蔽记忆 token 的不同子集、观测最终答案得分的变化，估计每个记忆 token 对最终答案的贡献度；再把这些 token 级分数映射回产生它们的记忆动作，转化为局部过程奖励，与全局结果奖励结合用于策略优化。这样策略不仅知道任务整体是否成功，也知道每个记忆动作内部哪些内容真正有用。
summary.experiments: 节选内容未给出具体实验设置和数值结果，仅从问题定义和方法动机层面描述了与启发式记忆方法、任务性能 RL、结果重分配奖励（如 Mem-T）、QA 派生动作奖励（如 MemBuilder）的区别。完整论文应包含在长交互记忆基准（如 LoCoMo、LongMemEval 类）上的对比，但具体数字需查阅正文。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–20 分钟。主要看方法部分的归因奖励如何构造（遮蔽策略、贡献度估计、token 级到动作级的聚合方式），以及它与 Mem-T、MemBuilder 等在反馈粒度上的差异。对基座预训练研究者而言，可借鉴其“用输出变化反传中间过程信用”的思路，但不必深挖 Agent 实验细节。

summary_en.core_problem: An LLM agent's memory-construction policy must decide what to extract, store, update, compress, or discard across long interactions. Existing RL-based memory-learning methods rely mainly on outcome- or action-level rewards, which cannot identify which specific tokens in intermediate memory contents actually support the final answer, creating a fine-grained credit-assignment bottleneck. Manually constructing ground-truth process labels is infeasible because the relevant evidence depends on the agent's own reasoning trajectory.
summary_en.importance: Relevant to process-supervision design for agent memory learning; sits in the post-train / agent-method space and is only loosely connected to base-model pretraining. The main useful idea is converting final task performance into dense, token-level rewards over intermediate memory outputs via attribution, providing fine-grained feedback without manual process annotations. This is conceptually related to broader credit-assignment techniques that propagate outcome reward back to intermediate steps.
summary_en.technical_approach: AttriMem adds an attribution-guided process-feedback layer on top of a standard RL memory-learning pipeline. During training, the policy produces intermediate memory outputs, a fixed retrieval-and-answering interface produces the final answer, and an outcome reward scores overall task success. Beyond this global reward, AttriMem masks different subsets of memory tokens and measures the resulting change in the final-answer score to estimate each token's contribution. These token-level scores are mapped back to the memory actions that produced them and converted into local process rewards, which are combined with the global outcome reward to update the policy. The policy thus receives feedback not only on overall success but also on which specific contents inside each memory action are useful.
summary_en.experiments: The excerpt does not include concrete experimental setups or numbers; it motivates the method by contrasting it with heuristic memory, task-performance RL, outcome-redistribution rewards (e.g., Mem-T), and QA-derived action rewards (e.g., MemBuilder). The full paper likely reports results on long-interaction memory benchmarks such as LoCoMo or LongMemEval, but specific figures require the main text.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, about 15–20 minutes. Focus on how the attribution reward is constructed—the masking strategy, the contribution estimator, and the aggregation from token-level scores back to action-level rewards—and how its feedback granularity differs from Mem-T and MemBuilder. For pretraining researchers, the transferable idea is the general pattern of inferring intermediate credit from output perturbations; the agent-specific experimental details can be skipped.

recommendation.en: Novel solution for agent memory credit assignment; attribution-guided process feedback transfers to long-term memory training, check §3 for feedback generation logic

summary.importance: 针对 agent 工具调用的来源审计与对抗鲁棒性做了受控测量，给出具体错误率与错误模式，对 agent 训练数据/上下文安全有参考价值。
